sections.heading: What we scan: public records only
sections.body: A free scan reads what a stranger can already see: the public DNS records for your domain (SPF, DKIM, DMARC). It sends nothing to your systems, logs into nothing and probes no ports.
sections.needle: We never scan or probe a system that has not agreed to it.

sections.heading: What we never do
sections.body: We never scan or probe a system that has not agreed to it. We never replace anyone on your team, and your IT provider stays in charge. We never use fake urgency or fear to sell.
sections.needle: We never scan or probe a system that has not agreed to it.

sections.heading: Privacy
sections.body: How we handle your details is set out in full on the privacy page and the your-data page, including what we keep and for how long.

sections.heading: AI disclosure
sections.body: Drafts across this site and in our reports are written with AI assistance and checked by Kyle Deligny before they reach you. Where a funder or platform asks whether AI wrote something, the true answer is yes.

sections.heading: Refunds
sections.body: Compliance engagements: a full refund within 14 days of payment, provided no deliverable has been issued. Monitor: cancel any time, with no refund for the current billing period. Other engagements: the refund terms are in the written scope you receive before you pay.
